description: Public-data native 1.0.0 probe: relabel existing LC0 100k positions with Stockfish d12, then continue from the current best native v4 Bullet weights. LC0 position data is ODbL and this lane is not strict Enyo-only.

validation.promotion_gate: First compare against current native v4. Only run Berserk if this is clearly positive or materially changes the gap.
validation.ownership_definition: No external net weights. Public LC0 positions are allowed and require ODbL attribution; Stockfish is the scalar oracle labeler.
validation.reason: The strict-native v4 line improves over v2 but remains far below Berserk. This isolates whether public LC0 positions provide a large data-distribution gain without changing architecture.
